source_documents.title: Cucurbituril hosts as promoters of aggregation induced emission of triphenylamine derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: very broad 1H NMR signals indicating aggregation which hampered the interpretation of the results
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1p/TPA2p/TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: NMR at approximately millimolar concentration, compared with micromolar optical experiments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Broad NMR signals prevented a clear interpretation of binding and protonation; the study therefore relied on optical titrations.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not claim this paper has NMR-confirmed target-specific binding geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No interaction was detected at this pH value, even though a big excess of CB7 was added
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1p/TPA2p/TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: pH 12 where amines are deprotonated; main-text description of SI Fig. S16.
reference_evidence_units.statement: No detectable CB7 interaction is reported at pH 12, supporting the role of positive charges in binding under other conditions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Underlying SI not inspected. The negative result is condition-specific and does not exclude alkaline aggregation of the host-free ligands.

reference_evidence_units.quote: host–guest interactions between the CB7 host and the ligand guest restrict the intra-molecular rotation of the benzene rings and enable AIE
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1p/TPA2p/TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source conclusion integrating optical titrations and lifetime data.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors explain emission enhancement through host binding and restriction of internal benzene-ring rotation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is the series-level source interpretation, not direct torsional dynamics measured separately for each target.

reference_evidence_units.quote: J-aggregates are still present despite the fact that in the emission spectra no band centred at 434 nm is clearly visible.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1p/TPA2p/TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2 and associated discussion; acidic host-bound systems.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns an intermediate lifetime component to emissive J-aggregates even where a distinct long-wavelength band is not clearly resolved.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve the published interpretation, but its specificity is weaker for TPA1p/TPA2p than for TPA3p. A fitted lifetime component alone is not definitive J-aggregate identification.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2, visually checked; ligand 5 micromolar, pH 3, excitation 268 nm; ligand:CB7 1:3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A three-component fit gives decay times 0.66, 2.77, 7.86 ns. Emission channels are 375 and 484 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are fitted decay components, not separately measured radiative rates or direct proof of three distinct mechanisms.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a new emission band centred at around 480 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous solution at pH 3, TPA3p:CB7 1:3; Fig. 5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: CB7 addition produces a new emission band near 480 nm. Excitation at 375 nm selectively yields the long-wavelength emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The authors interpret this as J-aggregate emission; spectral selectivity supports distinct emitting populations but is not crystal-resolved exciton geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPA3p and CB7 is 1 : 3 at pH = 3, but a 1 : 2 complex is formed at pH = 7.4.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Job analysis across pH conditions; source summarizes SI Fig. S15.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The assigned stoichiometry changes with pH. Table 1 gives log beta3 15.86 at pH 3 and log beta2 11.53 at pH 7.4.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are overall constants for different stoichiometries, not directly comparable per-binding-event affinity values.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Various cycles of basic and acidic pH were performed to show the reversibility
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 7c; cycles between approximately pH 2.5 and 11.5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper demonstrates reversible switching of aggregate-associated emission with pH-driven host association and dissociation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The control supports condition-dependent assembly; it is not an excited-state proton-transfer observation.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA3p with CB7
reference_evidence_units.statement: DLS gives a reported mean aggregate size of 126 +/- 5 nm and dispersity 0.117 for TPA3p.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Particle size supports assembly, not excitonic identity by itself.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the authors' host-assisted motion-restriction interpretation. Lifetime and intensity data are indirect support, not measured internal torsions.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The host-associated aggregate environment supplies external constraints. This overlaps with host binding and RIM rather than identifying an independent additive cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Condition-dependent CB7 binding is central to the source explanation. Optical models and controls support association, but NMR did not independently resolve binding geometry.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source assigns the new long-wavelength band and aggregate-associated decay to J-aggregates; the assignment is condition-dependent and not a resolved packing geometry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism is established. Changing solution pH or ground-state protonation alone does not establish ESIPT.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established by the selected source evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Lifetime or intensity changes alone do not isolate radiative rates or a distinct bright/dark-state mechanism. Do not duplicate a generic nonradiative explanation as a separate established pathway.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-mediated or energy-transfer mechanism is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection calculation or assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emissive mechanism or anti-Kasha assignment is established in the selected evidence.
